name: Suez shareholder consortium (Meridiam, Global Infrastructure Partners, Caisse des Dépôts/CNP Assurances, employee shareholders)
via: Stakes in SUEZ held via SUEZ Holding
note: Shareholding shown on suez.com's governance page: Meridiam 38.3%, Global Infrastructure Partners (a part of BlackRock) 38.3%, Caisse des Dépôts and CNP Assurances 18.8%, Go SUEZ employee shareholding 4.4%, plus 0.2% treasury shares. The page describes Caisse des Dépôts as 'A French public-sector financial institution'.
